items.title: Palantir stock tumbles as Google encroaches on defense AI market
items.summary: Investing.com -- Palantir Technologies (NYSE:PLTR) shares plunged 7% on Wednesday. While the broader market context remains complex, the sharp sell-off appears directly tied to Google’s sudden entry into Palantir’s most lucrative territory: specialized government and defense AI. The decline accelerated shortly after Google DeepMind unveiled Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber, a specialized artificial intelligence model built explicitly for cybersecurity, vulnerability detection, and automated patching.
